title: 1 Enoch 75 — The four season-leaders and the epact-days that humans err in not counting

translation.sourceText: 1 Enoch Astronomical Book (Book of the Luminaries / Sefer ha-Mazzalot) — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Aramaic DSS 4Q208-4Q211, OLDEST surviving Enoch material late 3rd c. paragraphs.text: ወአዕራግ፡ ርእሰ፡ ዕለታት፡ መርሖሙ፡ ዘበዐርብ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዓለም፡ ላዕለ፡ ስብዓቱ፡ መንበራት፡ ለፀሐይ፡ መርሖሙ፡ ይትኬለልዎሙ፡ ወያስተሣዕልዎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿrāg rəʾsa ʿəlatāt marḥomu zaba-ʿarb mangəśtomu lāʿla ʿālam lāʿla səbʿātu manbarāt la-ḍaḥay marḥomu yətkēlaləwwomu wa-yāstaśāʿəlwommu

i18n.en: And the leaders of the heads of the days, whose rule is over the world together with the leaders over the seven stations of the sun — these their leaders encompass and supervise them.

notes.official: **The four season-leaders — the angelic supervisors of the four 91-day quarters.** The Ge'ez *ʾaʿrāg* ('leaders / chiefs') introduces the four season-leaders who supervise the four 91-day quarters of the 364-day solar year. The four are named explicitly at 1 En 82:11-20 (Melkiel, Helemmelek, Meleyal, Narel — see commentary at ch 82). The angelic-administrative-leadership-of-the-seasons is integral to the 364-day-calendar framework. Uriel is the overall cosmic-administrative-angel; the four season-leaders are the next-level subordinates with portfolio over the four 91-day quarters. See central entries `uriel-angel-over-luminaries-1-enoch-72-79-82-cross-corpus` and `qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: ወእልክቱ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ዘዐሥርቱ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ይትኬለሉ፡ መርሖሙ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ ዑርኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ መርሖሙ፡ ምክንያቶሙ፡ አርባዕተ፡ ዕለታት፡ ዘይትዌሰክ፡ ኢተሐስቡ፡ በውስተ፡ ኆለቅ፡ ለዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəlləktu ʾarbāʿtu zaʿaśərtu məśrāq yətkēlalu marḥomu baba gizēhomu wa-yəbēlanī ʿUrʾēl malʾak zawəʾətu marḥomu məkənyātomu ʾarbāʿta ʿəlatāt zayətwēsak ʾitaḥasabu ba-wəsta ḫolaq la-ʿāmat

i18n.en: And those four leaders of the east are surrounded by their leaders in their times; and Uriel, the holy angel who is their leader, said to me: their cause is the four days that are added, that are not counted in the reckoning of the year.

notes.official:
**The four epact-days polemic — stated in Uriel's own voice.** This is one of the sharpest polemical-statements of the Astronomical Book. Uriel identifies the cause of the four 'leaders of the east' as the FOUR epact-days that are added (the days that bring the schematic 360-day base year to 364) — the days that 'are not counted in the reckoning of the year' by those who err in the calendar. The polemic targets the proto-Rabbinic / Pharisaic / Temple-Establishment tradition's lunar-solar calendar that does NOT count these four epact-days; the Astronomical Book holds the four epact-days as integral to the 364-day solar year. The polemic is sharpened at v. 3 ('humans err in these — they swiftly go astray concerning them') and continues at chs 82:4-6.

See central entry `qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus` for the systematic treatment of the 364-day calendar as the calendrical-identity-keystone of the Qumran-Enochic-Jubilees corpus.

paragraphs.text: ወይትዐጻዑ፡ በውስቴቶሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወይሰሐቱ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ፍጡነ፡ እስመ፡ እልክቱ፡ ብርሃናት፡ የአምሕሩ፡ ጊዜያተ፡ ለዓለም፡ በውስተ፡ መንበረ፡ ዓለም፡ አሐደ፡ በቀዳማይ፡ አንቀጽ፡ ወአሐደ፡ በሣልስ፡ ወአሐደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ወአሐደ፡ በሳድስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətʿaḍāʿu ba-wəstētomu sabʾ wa-yəsaḥtu kiyāhu fəṭuna ʾəsma ʾəlləktu bərhānāt yāʾəmḥəru gizēyāta la-ʿālam ba-wəsta manbara ʿālam ʾaḥada ba-qadāmāyə ʾanqaḍ wa-ʾaḥada ba-śāləs wa-ʾaḥada ba-rābəʿ wa-ʾaḥada ba-sādəs

i18n.en: And humans err in these — they swiftly go astray concerning them — for those luminaries truly serve the seasons of the world in the stations of the world: one in the first gate, one in the third, one in the fourth, and one in the sixth.

notes.official:
**'Humans err' — the sharpest polemical statement of the Astronomical Book.** The Ge'ez *wa-yətʿaḍāʿu ba-wəstētomu sabʾ wa-yəsaḥtu kiyāhu fəṭuna* — 'humans err in these — they swiftly go astray concerning them' — names the calendrical-error directly as a human-error. The four epact-days are anchored in the four corner-gates of the sun's annual circuit: gate 1 (winter-solstice), gate 3 (vernal-equinox), gate 4 (summer-solstice), gate 6 (autumnal-equinox). The four 31-day-months at the solstice-and-equinox-junctures provide the four extra epact-days that the polemic targets.

The polemical-edge of v. 3 is one of the most-distinctive features of the Astronomical Book: the calendrical-difference is framed as a moral-error of humans, not merely a calculational-difference. The framework is shared with Jubilees 6:32-38 (the parallel polemic: 'they will forget the new moons and the times and the sabbaths, and they will make mistakes in all the new months and times and sabbaths').

paragraphs.text: ወይትፌጸም፡ ድካም፡ ለዓመት፡ ፍጹመ፡ በውስተ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ስድሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ መንበራት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətfēṣam dəkām la-ʿāmat fəṣṣuma ba-wəsta śallastu məʾət sədsā wa-ʾarbāʿtu manbarāt

i18n.en: And the whole labor of the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four stations.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ ምክንያተ፡ ለዓለም፡ ይትገበሩ፡ ለሕገጊሁ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወለወርኅ፡ ወለከዋክብት፡ ወለኵሉ፡ ሐራ፡ ለዓለም፡ ዘፈጠረ፡ ዘበአስተራኩሞ፡ ይስተራኩሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ቀዋምት፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma məkənyāta la-ʿālam yətgabbaru la-ḥəgagihu la-ḍaḥay wa-la-warḫ wa-la-kawākəbt wa-la-kwəlu ḥarā la-ʿālam zafaṭara zabaʾəstarākumo yəstarākumu kwəlomu qawāmt la-ʿālam

i18n.en: For the causes of the world are performed for it according to the laws of the sun and the moon and the stars, and of all the host of the world which he created — that by their conjoined order all the stations of the world might be ordered together.

paragraphs.text: ወእንተ፡ ኮኑ፡ ስብዐቱ፡ መሣክወ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ዘፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ እምውስቴቱ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡ ስብዐ፡ ዘይትዐጻዑ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡ ወይትገብኡ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ መሣክወ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾənta konu səbʿatu masākəwa ʿabayta zaḍaḥay wa-warḫ ʾəmwəstētu yəwaḍḍəʾ bərhānomu lāʿla manbarātihomu səbʿa zayətʿaḍāʿu manbarātihomu wa-yətgabbəʾu kiyāhomu masākəwa laba-gizēhu

i18n.en: And there are twelve great windows of the sun and the moon, from which their light comes forth upon their stations seven times — those that encompass their stations — and the windows receive them again in their times.

paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረ፡ ኆለቅ፡ ዘስብዐቱ፡ መሣክው፡ ዘፀሐይ፡ ይትገብኡ፡ ለመሥራቅ፡ ወይዐርቡ፡ በውስቴቶሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra ḫolaq zasəbʿatu masākəw zaḍaḥay yətgabbəʾu la-maśrāq wa-yəʿarrəbu ba-wəstētomu

i18n.en: And after the reckoning of the twelve windows of the sun, they return to the east, and through them the sun sets.

paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረ፡ ሕገገዘ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ አርአየኒ፡ ቀዋምቶሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወዐሥር፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra ḥəgagaza ḫolaqomu la-kawākəbt ʾarʾayanī qawāmtomu kwəlomu wa-ʿaśr wa-kəlʾētu manbarātihomu

i18n.en: And after these laws — the reckoning of the stars — he showed me all their stations, and their twelve stations.

paragraphs.text: ወአዕናቅፅ፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ፀዓፋተ፡ መንፈስ፡ ኅሉቅ፡ ይከውን፡ በውስቴቶሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ መንፈስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿnāqəḍ zayəwaḍḍəʾ ʾəmwəstētomu ḍaʿāfāta manfas ḫəluq yəkawwən ba-wəstētomu kwəlu manfas

i18n.en: And the gates from which the winds issue — the appointed places of the wind — every wind is in them according to its measure.
